summary: First full test run of the Small Team CRM (backend + frontend). Created a pytest regression suite (52 tests) covering auth/JWT/cookies/lockout, RBAC for all 4 roles, lead CRUD + duplicate-by-phone, filters/buckets/pagination, manual assign, round-robin auto-assign, CSV import, public webhook intake, 12h escalation + cron endpoint, reports/dashboard/performance, activities, users & teams management. 50/52 passed. Frontend Playwright runs covered login for all 4 roles + role routing + route guards, telecaller workspace (queue tabs, call note, status change, shadcn follow-up date/hour picker, persistence after reload), admin leads page (6 buckets, 3 filters, search, new-lead dialog, row select + bulk assign, CSV import, auto-assign, lead drawer/panel), users & teams CRUD (create user, toggle active, team assign, create team), dashboard KPIs + charts + run-escalation button + KPI drill-down, reports (admin/sub-admin/team-leader scoping) and activity log. All frontend flows passed; 2 genuine backend defects found.

critical.issue: Escalation ignores call notes. run_escalation() selects on {status:'assigned', assigned_at < now-12h} only, so a lead where the telecaller logged a call note (status left on 'assigned') is still escalated + reassigned. Spec is 'no status update AND no call note = no action'. Reproduced by tests/backend_test.py::TestEscalation::test_lead_with_call_note_is_not_escalated. Fix: also require last_action_at to be older than the cutoff, e.g. {'$or':[{'last_action_at':None},{'last_action_at':{'$lt':cutoff}}]}.

Lockout identifier is f"{request.client.host}:{email}" - behind the k8s ingress request.client.host is the proxy pod IP and rotates, so the counter is partitioned across IPs. Observed 15 consecutive bad-password attempts returning [401 x7, 429, 429, 429, 401, 429, 401, 429, 401] i.e. lock never engages deterministically at 5 and 401s keep flowing through. Key the counter by email (optionally + X-Forwarded-For) and reset count once the lock window expires (currently count is never reset, so an account re-locks on the very next failure forever).

minor.issue: allow_origin_regex='.*' combined with allow_credentials=True is a wildcard-with-credentials configuration; playbook requires explicit origins (preview URL + localhost).

Gated by require_perm(user,'lead:delete') instead of 'user:manage'. Sub-admin (who is allowed to manage telecallers/team leaders) gets 403 on this endpoint; only admin can call it. Wrong permission key.
bucket=today uses now.replace(hour=0..)/replace(hour=23..) on a UTC 'now', so 'due today' is a UTC day, not the team's local day - Indian evening follow-ups can fall in the wrong bucket.
'lead:delete' permission exists but there is no lead delete/archive endpoint, so bad/duplicate leads cannot be removed via API.

ui_bugs.issue: Console error on every open: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users'. Add a (visually hidden) SheetTitle/DialogTitle.
No pagination control although the API is paged (limit=50). Once the pipeline exceeds 50 leads the rest are unreachable from the UI (total is displayed but page cannot be changed).

Search text (q) and status/source filters persist when switching bucket tabs, so 'Unassigned/Escalated' can silently show 0 rows while a stale search is active. Consider clearing q or showing an active-filter chip.
When a lead has no activity rows the 'Activity' heading renders with an empty body (no empty-state text), unlike Call notes which has one.

issues: Recharts logs 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' 4x on first mount - ResponsiveContainer has no minWidth/minHeight; charts do render after layout but the initial frame is empty.
SelectItem options inside filter-status / filter-source / filter-assignee have no data-testid (only bulk-assign and status/reassign options do); tests must fall back to role=option text matching.

action_items: Fix run_escalation() to treat a call note as activity (filter on last_action_at, not only assigned_at/status).
Fix login lockout identifier (email-based, not proxy client IP) and reset the counter when the 15-min window expires.
Replace CORS allow_origin_regex='.*' with explicit allowed origins while keeping allow_credentials.
Add pagination controls to the Leads table (API already returns total/page).
Add SheetTitle/DialogTitle (visually hidden) to LeadDrawer to clear the radix a11y error.
critical_code_review_comments: run_escalation(): the 12h rule only inspects status+assigned_at; a telecaller who logs a call note without changing status is still punished. Use max(assigned_at, last_action_at) as the idle marker.

login(): db.login_attempts key uses request.client.host which is the ingress IP behind k8s; brute-force protection is effectively bypassable and non-deterministic. Also count is never zeroed after lock expiry.
delete_user() uses require_perm(user, 'lead:delete') - copy/paste permission mismatch with the documented 'sub-admin manages telecallers/team leaders' rule.
GET /api/leads bucket=today/overdue computes day boundaries in UTC; for an India-based calling team the 'Due today' queue will roll over at 05:30 IST.

next_telecaller() increments a single shared db.settings counter per call, and when exclude filters the list the modulo index shifts - distribution is fair enough but not strictly round-robin per telecaller; acceptable for MVP, worth a comment.
server.py is 715 lines and already mixes auth, leads, reports, escalation and cron routes - split into routers before it grows further.
seed_data_creation: All API/UI test artifacts were prefixed TEST_ (leads/teams) or test_ (user emails) and deleted after the run (36 leads, 7 users, 3 teams removed; login_attempts cleared). NOTE: clicking the UI 'Auto assign' button reassigned the 12 seeded demo leads across telecallers and 2 seeded leads (Ishita Shah / Tarun Chopra) are now escalated=true - seeded lead ownership differs from seed_demo.py output. Re-run `python /app/backend/seed_demo.py` if pristine demo data is required.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is complete and all 7 accounts log in successfully (admin@crm.com/admin123, subadmin|leader1|leader2|caller1|caller2|caller3 /pass123). bcrypt hashes verified as $2b$ format; login sets httpOnly access_token+refresh_token cookies.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/ (conftest.py + backend_test.py, 52 tests, run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v`). pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; the DB cleanup fixture is intentionally gated behind CRM_TEST_CLEANUP=1 because per-worker cleanup deleted rows another worker was still using - run cleanup manually after the suite. Two tests are expected to FAIL until the developer fixes the defects: TestAuth::test_brute_force_lockout (IP-partitioned lockout) and TestEscalation::test_lead_with_call_note_is_not_escalated (escalation ignores call notes). Everything else (RBAC for 4 roles, duplicate phone 409, CSV import counts 1/1/1, intake key 401/duplicate, round-robin spread, cron 401/200, reports scoping, users/teams CRUD) passes both on API and UI. Frontend data-testids are complete for every flow tested; only the leads filter SelectItems lack testids.
rca_of_the_issue: Escalation: run_escalation() query = {status:'assigned', assigned_to != None, assigned_at < now-12h}. add_note() updates notes/last_action_at/escalated but does not touch status or assigned_at, so any lead whose telecaller logged a note yet left the stage on 'assigned' still matches the stale query and is escalated + reassigned (reproduced: TEST_Noted lead, note added, escalation run -> escalated=true, owner changed). Lockout: identifier embeds request.client.host; the preview ingress sends requests from multiple proxy pod IPs (observed 10.79.139.10 and 10.79.139.11 in db.login_attempts), splitting the 5-strike counter across identifiers, so a client keeps getting 401s past the threshold and the lock engages non-deterministically.
